title: This App Is Making 2 000 Per Day
lightpanda-io/browser
snippet: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation https://lightpanda.io Lightpanda Browser The headless browser built from scratch for AI agents and automation. Not a Chromium fork. Not a WebKit patch. A new browser, written in Zig. 16x lighter and 9x faster than Chromium. Benchmarks Requesting 933 real web pages over the network on a AWS EC2 m5.large instance. See benchmark details . Metric Lightpanda Headless Chrome Difference Memory (peak, 100 pages) 123MB 2GB ~16x less Execution time (100 pages) 5s 46s ~9x faster Quick start Install Package Managers Latest nightly from Homebrew: brew install lightpanda-io/browser/lightpanda Latest nightly from Arch Linux User Repository: yay -S lightpanda-nightly-bin Download from the nightly builds You can download the last binary from the nightly builds for Linux and MacOS for both x86_64 and aarch64. For Linux curl -L -o lightpanda h
